data.long_meaning: Sumit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'sumati', which means 'good intellect' or 'wise'. It is a name given to a child who is believed to possess strong intellectual abilities and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Sumit is also associated with Lord Shiva, the God of Destruction and Renewal. The name Sumit carries the meaning “Good, Wise, Name” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sumit usually hope their child will grow to embody good, wise, name and live with faith, good character and purpose.
